title: aspalathus laricifolia subsp. canescens
intro: Aspalathus laricifolia subsp. canescens, commonly known as Rooibos, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is native to South Africa and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rooibos include reducing stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Rooibos include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and aspalathin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
